name: Green Aventurine
description: The gambler's stone. Aventurine is traditionally worn for luck, new opportunities and the confidence to say yes to them.
mineral: Green aventurine is a quartz rock rather than a single crystal. Tiny flakes of the green mica fuchsite give it its soft colour and a faint sparkle known as aventurescence.
wornFor: A green aventurine bracelet is traditionally worn for luck, opportunity and a hopeful, open outlook. It belongs to the heart chakra and is linked with Taurus and Virgo. People often choose it before interviews, exams or a new venture, and it is a common gift for someone starting out. Aventurine is water safe and sun safe, so it is easy to wear every day.
wristWhy: Wear green aventurine on the left wrist, the receiving side in most traditions. Luck and opportunity stones are worn to invite something in.
